nearMatches.title: Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer
nearMatches.text: Category: IT Services Location: Chennai Tamil Nadu India Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Azure, Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift, combined with solid application development and DevOps skills. The role involves designing and managing scalable cloud platforms, implementing Infrastructure as Code, optimizing performance, and building advanced simulators and test environments to support enterprise-grade applications. Key Responsibilities Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Management Design, deploy, and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including: Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets, and connectivity Compute resources (VMs, AKS, scale sets) Storage solutions (Blob, Disk, Files) Security services (Key Vault, Azure AD integration, policies) Architect, implement, and maintain Red Hat OpenShift container platforms for enterprise application deployment. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform for repeatable, auditable environment provisioning. Manage Kubernetes clusters (Azure Kubernetes Service / OpenShift) and orchestrate containerized applications across multiple environments. Performance & Optimization Plan and conduct comprehensive performance testing using tools like JMeter and Neoload. Analyze application and infrastructure performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and resource constraints. Implement performance tuning strategies for cloud resources, container platforms, and applications. Define and maintain performance benchmarks, SLAs, and SLOs for critical systems and services. Networking & Security Design and implement Azure networking solutions including: VNets, subnets, peering, and VPN/ExpressRoute Network Security Groups (NSGs), firewalls, and routing Application Gateways, Load Balancers, and ingress solutions Configure and manage OpenShift networking components such as SDN, ingress controllers, and network policies. Implement and enforce security best practices for cloud and container environments, including identity, access management, and compliance controls. Troubleshoot complex networking issues across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, collaborating with infrastructure and security teams. Application Development & DevOps Develop and maintain cloud-native applications using modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, C#, or similar). Design and develop simulators for testing, training, and validation purposes, supporting various system and integration scenarios. Build mock services and virtual environments to simulate real-world systems, third-party integrations, and external APIs. Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment using GitHub Actions (and other DevOps tools as needed). Collaborate with development teams to optimize application architecture for cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency. Create automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) for infrastructure management and deployment workflows. Build realistic simulators to replicate production environments, external dependencies, and failure scenarios. Develop test harnesses and simulation frameworks to support load testing, resilience testing, and chaos engineering. Build training and sandbox environments for development, QA, and experimentation. Design data-driven simulators with configurable scenarios and behaviors to support complex business and operational use cases. Required Skills & Experience Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services (networking, compute, storage, security). Experience architecting and administering Red Hat OpenShift or other enterprise Kubernetes platforms. Practical experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform (or similar tools). Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes, containers (Docker), and microservices. Proven experience in performance testing using JMeter, Neoload, or equivalent tools. Strong grasp of cloud networking concepts, security controls, and hybrid connectivity solutions. Experience developing cloud-native applications using at least one modern programming language. Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines (preferably with GitHub Actions) and integrating with cloud platforms. Experience creating simulators, mock services, and complex test environments for application and integration testing. Good understanding of DevOps practices, automation, and observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing). Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical issues across infrastructure, networking, and applications. Clear verbal and written communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (development, QA, operations, security, and business stakeholders). Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Proactive attitude, willingness to learn new technologies, and ownership mindset for assigned tasks and deliverables. High attention to detail and strong commitment to quality, reliability, and operational excellence. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). Relevant certifications in Azure, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or DevOps will be an added advantage. Details

Additional Nice-to-Have: Experience with incident management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, JIRA). Knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management). Basic scripting (Shell, Python, etc.) for automation of routine tasks. Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience). ​ Details

closest.title: Embedded Controls Engineer, Spacecraft
closest.text:
Katalyst Description:

We build robotic spacecraft that enable dynamic space operations, creating a future where maneuvering, upgrading, refueling, and exploration are as routine as they are on Earth. Getting to space and overcoming the gravity well is only half the story. What you do there is the future. We are not building the trains. We are building the machines that lay down the tracks. By developing the foundational capabilities that make sustained, responsive operations possible, we enable a new era of space activity that strengthens national security and ensures freedom of action in an increasingly contested domain.

Katalyst Culture:

Working at Katalyst is intense, hands-on, and deeply rewarding. You’ll take real ownership and see your work move from concept to operations in an environment where the problems are hard and the impact is real. We value humility, craftsmanship, and doing things the right way, even when it’s harder. You’ll work closely with thoughtful, driven teammates who push each other to do their best. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Design, implement, and validate embedded control software for spacecraft subsystems including propulsion, robotics, avionics, and vehicle actuation systems. 
  • Develop real-time control algorithms and flight software that interface directly with sensors, actuators, and spacecraft hardware. 
  • Support the bring-up, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of embedded hardware and software across laboratory, test, and flight environments. 
  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, robotics, and flight software engineers to mature systems from concept through flight operations. 
  • Own system performance through testing, verification, and mission execution, ensuring reliable operation in demanding environments. 

 

What We’re Looking For 

Required 

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical discipline. 
  • 4+ years of experience developing embedded software and control systems for aerospace, robotics, autonomous systems, industrial automation, automotive, defense, or other high-reliability applications. 
  • Strong experience developing embedded software in C/C++ for real-time or resource-constrained systems. 
  • 1 year of experience with FPGAs (VHDL preferred) 
  • Experience implementing and tuning control systems using classical and/or modern control techniques. 
  • Familiarity with embedded communication protocols such as CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, or Ethernet. 
  • Ability to independently debug complex hardware-software interactions using laboratory test equipment and structured engineering processes. 

 

Your Ideal Background 

Preferred  

  • Master's degree or higher in Controls, Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Experience developing guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) systems, robotics controls, or spacecraft flight software. 
  • Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS), embedded Linux, or safety-critical software development practices. 
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), and automated test frameworks. 
  • Previous work on aerospace, defense, autonomous systems, robotics, or other high-reliability embedded systems. 

 

Additional Requirements: Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed. 

 

Additional Requirements: Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed. 

Compensation and Benefits: Your base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. The anticipated salary range for this role is $100,000 - $160,000 annually.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at Katalyst. You will also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of the Employee Stock Option and Equity Plan, as well as a relocation bonus and other discretionary bonuses. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, and unlimited Paid Time Off.

closest.title: The Developer’s Guide to Vector Databases in 2026: Beyond the Hype
closest.text: Vector Databases for Developers in 2026 - RAG, Indexing, & How to Choose --> --> --> --> Home Company About Us Tearms and Conditions Privacy Policy Contact Us Services AI & GenAI Solutions Web & Platform Development Consulting & Scalable Architecture Product Design & UX Marketing & Growth Accounting Finance- Virtual Hiring Partnering Products Blogs We Are Hiring The Developer’s Guide to Vector Databases in 2026: Beyond the Hype By Joey Ricard - April 10, 2026 SHARE ON --> --> --> --> --> In the early 2020s, vector databases were the “new kids on the block”—a niche requirement for specialized machine learning teams. Fast forward to 2026, and they have become as fundamental to the modern tech stack as PostgreSQL or Redis. If you are building with LLMs, autonomous agents, or multimodal AI, you aren’t just managing data anymore; you’re managing meaning . Traditional databases are great for answering “What is the price of item X?” but they fail miserably at “Find me products that feel like a summer breeze.” This shift from exact matching to semantic similarity is why vector databases are now a multi-billion dollar industry. What Is a Vector Database? A Developer-Focused Explanation A vector database is a system purpose-built to store, index, and query data as high-dimensional embeddings — dense numerical representations of unstructured data like text, images, audio, and code. Unlike relational databases that store rows and columns, vector databases store the mathematical meaning of data. Whether it’s a paragraph, a 4K video clip, or a user’s purchase history, an embedding model converts it into a fixed-length array of floats: [0.12, -0.59, 0.88, ..., 0.04] In a 1536-dimensional space (standard for many 2026 embedding models), the vector for “Smartphone” sits mathematically closer to “Android” than to “Banana.” This is the core principle that makes semantic search engineering possible — and it’s why vector databases for developers have become as essential as PostgreSQL or Redis. Why Keywords Are Dying: Semantic Search vs. Keyword Search For decades, we relied on Inverted Indexes (the tech behind Elasticsearch). If you searched for “crimson footwear,” and the database only had “red shoes,” you got zero results. Vector databases solve this via Semantic Search. Traditional: Matches strings (Exact or Fuzzy). Vector: Matches intent and context. By 2026, we’ve reached a point where Hybrid Search is the gold standard. Modern developers use a combination of BM25 (keyword) and vector search to ensure that results are both semantically relevant and contain the specific technical terms required. The Architecture of a Vector Database: How the Pipeline Works Building a production-ready AI application on vector databases requires understanding the full data pipeline — it’s not just “insert and query.” The Vector Data Pipeline: Ingestion — Raw data (text, images, PDFs) is collected. Embedding — An embedding model (OpenAI’s text-embedding-3 , open-source BGE-M3 , or Cohere’s embed-v4 ) converts data into high-dimensional embeddings. Indexing — The database builds a specialized data structure (HNSW, DiskANN, or PQ) for fast approximate retrieval. Querying — The user’s input is embedded in real-time, and the DB returns the nearest neighbors. This pipeline is the backbone of every RAG system, recommendation engine, and semantic search application in 2026. HNSW vs DiskANN: Indexing Algorithms Every Developer Must Know You can’t run a linear scan across 100 million vectors — it would take seconds, an eternity at production scale. Instead, developers use Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) algorithms. HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) HNSW builds a multi-layered graph: top layers have fewer nodes for fast navigation, bottom layers contain all points for precision. ✅ Incredible speed and high recall ❌ Memory-heavy — your entire index lives in RAM DiskANN By 2026, DiskANN has become the go-to for trillion-scale datasets. It stores the bulk of the index on SSDs instead of expensive RAM, making scaling vector databases for trillions of embeddings financially viable. ✅ Handles massive scale at a fraction of the cost ❌ Slightly higher latency than pure in-memory HNSW Product Quantization (PQ) Think of PQ as “vector compression.” It reduces vector size so you can fit more data into memory, trading a slight accuracy dip for major cost savings. Bottom line on HNSW vs DiskANN: Use HNSW for low-latency, high-recall workloads under ~10M vectors. Use DiskANN when scaling beyond that or when RAM budget is a constraint. RAG Architecture: Vector Databases as AI Long-Term Memory The most common use case for vector databases for developers in 2026 is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) . LLMs have knowledge cutoffs and limited context windows. A vector database acts as the model’s AI long-term memory — an external knowledge store that keeps responses accurate and current. How RAG architecture works: User asks a question. The query is embedded and searched against the vector database. The most relevant chunks are retrieved. These chunks are injected into the LLM’s prompt as context. The LLM generates a grounded, accurate response. Example: An AI support bot for a hardware company doesn’t know about yesterday’s manual update. With RAG, the bot queries the vector database for the latest manual sections and feeds that context to the LLM — no retraining required. Pro tip: For production RAG, always implement metadata filtering (e.g., filter by date, document type, or tenant ID) alongside vector similarity to improve precision. Decision Framework: Already on PostgreSQL? Start with pgvector . The pgvector performance in 2026 has improved dramatically with HNSW indexing support, and it eliminates the need for a separate database. Need zero-ops at scale? Go with Pinecone or Weaviate Cloud. Enterprise with compliance needs? Milvus on-prem gives you full control. Just prototyping? ChromaDB gets you from zero to vector search in minutes. Implementing vector search in 2026 for a greenfield project? Evaluate hybrid search support, metadata filtering performance, and multi-tenancy before committing. Key Challenges When Working with Vector Databases Vector databases are powerful, but watch out for these production gotchas: The Re-Embedding Problem — Change your embedding model (e.g., from OpenAI to Cohere)? You must re-embed your entire dataset. Vectors from different models are incompatible. Metadata Filtering at Scale — Not all vector DBs handle high-cardinality metadata filtering efficiently. Test this before committing. Cost Management — RAM is expensive. In 2026, savvy developers are moving toward serverless vector DBs (Pinecone Serverless, Weaviate Cloud) to pay per query, not per GB of RAM. Embedding Drift — As your embedding model gets updated, older vectors may become stale. Plan a re-indexing strategy from day one. FAQ: Vector Databases for Developers How do I choose a vector database for RAG? Start by evaluating your scale (thousands vs billions of vectors), infrastructure (cloud vs on-prem), and whether you need hybrid search. For most RAG applications, Pinecone or Weaviate offer the fastest path to production. If you’re already on PostgreSQL, pgvector is a strong starting point. What’s the difference between vector search and keyword search? Keyword search matches exact or fuzzy strings. Vector search matches semantic meaning — so “crimson footwear” finds “red shoes.” Most production systems in 2026 use hybrid search combining both. Is pgvector good enough for production? Yes — pgvector performance has improved significantly with HNSW index support. For datasets under ~5M vectors with moderate query load, it’s a solid choice that avoids adding new infrastructure. How do you scale vector databases for trillions of embeddings? Use DiskANN-based indexing (supported by Milvus and Microsoft’s proprietary solutions) to store indexes on SSD rather than RAM. Combine with sharding and tiered storage strategies. What is AI long-term memory? It refers to using a vector database as an external knowledge store for LLMs — enabling them to “remember” information beyond their training data and context window, typically via RAG architecture. Conclusion: The Future is Multi-Modal We are moving beyond text. The next frontier for developers is Multi-modal Vector Databases , where a single search can span images, audio, and code. As an engineer, mastering the vector stack isn’t just a resume-builder; it’s the price of entry for the AI era. Ready to start? closest.title: Hire AI Developers in India: What to Expect, What to Pay, What to Avoid
closest.text: Hire AI Developers in India: What to Expect, What to Pay, What to Avoid | Kodework Skip to main content kodework Home Services Pricing About Blog Case Studies Book a Call Home Services Pricing About Blog Case Studies Book a Call All posts hire AI developers AI developers India software development Goa dedicated developers India Hire AI Developers in India: What to Expect, What to Pay, What to Avoid India produces some of the world's best AI developers. This guide covers what to look for when hiring, typical rates, engagement models, and why Goa has emerged as a hub for premium AI development. K Kodework March 25, 2026 7 min read Contents India is home to some of the world’s most capable AI engineers. It is also home to a large number of development agencies that have rebranded as “AI-first” without meaningfully changing their practices. If you’re looking to hire AI developers in India — whether through a dedicated team, a project engagement, or a hybrid model — this guide will help you navigate the landscape, understand what you’re actually paying for, and avoid the patterns that produce expensive failures. Why India for AI Development? The talent argument for India isn’t about cost arbitrage anymore. That framing is both outdated and unfair to what India’s best engineering teams actually deliver. India produces roughly 1.5 million engineering graduates per year. A significant subset of those engineers have pursued advanced specialisation in machine learning, cloud infrastructure, and full-stack AI integration — often with experience at global companies including Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and a range of successful Indian product companies. The combination of deep technical experience, strong English communication skills, and familiarity with international product standards makes senior Indian AI engineers highly competitive with counterparts anywhere in the world. The cost advantage — a function of local living costs, not capability — is real, but it’s a byproduct, not the story. For businesses in Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia, hiring AI development capacity in India offers: Cost efficiency: Senior AI developers in India typically cost 40–60% less than equivalent hires in Western markets Scale: India’s talent pool is deep enough to staff dedicated teams across specialisations Time zone coverage: India (UTC+5:30) offers meaningful overlap with European business hours and end-of-day availability for East Coast US teams Track record: Indian development teams have built some of the world’s most-used software products What “AI Developer” Actually Means The term “AI developer” is used loosely. When evaluating candidates or agencies, it helps to clarify what kind of AI development you actually need: AI integration engineers build software that uses AI APIs — they integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or other AI services into applications. They handle prompt engineering, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) architecture, and AI-powered feature development within existing products. ML engineers build and train machine learning models. This requires deep knowledge of Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, data pipeline engineering, and model evaluation. It’s a different discipline from AI integration engineering. AI-augmented full-stack developers are engineers who use AI tooling — Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot — to accelerate their development work. They’re not AI specialists, but they deliver software at AI-assisted speeds with the full range of full-stack capability. For most business software projects — web applications, SaaS platforms, internal tools, AI-powered product features — you need the third category most. The first category if you’re building AI features. The second only if you’re training custom models. Knowing which you need will prevent mismatched engagements. Engagement Models Project-Based Engagement You scope a specific product or feature, agree on deliverables and price, and the agency builds and delivers it. This works well for: MVPs and initial product builds Specific feature additions to an existing product Rebuilds and migrations Fixed-price project engagements give you cost certainty and clear deliverables. The risk is scope creep — make sure your agreement includes a clear change process. Dedicated Team / Staff Augmentation You hire a team or individual engineers who work exclusively on your product for a defined period. Rates are typically monthly. This works well for: Ongoing product development with evolving requirements Extending an in-house team with specific skills Long-term platform development The advantage is flexibility and team continuity. The risk is productivity management — a dedicated team requires more active involvement from your side. Retainer / Ongoing Support Monthly retainer for ongoing feature development, maintenance, and support. Works well after an initial project engagement. Rate Expectations Role Freelance (monthly) Agency (monthly) Notes Junior AI developer (2–3 yrs) $1,500–$2,500 $2,500–$4,000 Limited oversight needed Mid-level AI developer (4–6 yrs) $3,000–$5,000 $4,500–$7,000 Strong for most product work Senior AI developer (7+ yrs) $5,000–$9,000 $7,000–$12,000 Architecture and complex builds Lead / Principal engineer $8,000–$14,000 $10,000–$18,000 Rare; high demand Agency rates include overhead (project management, tools, HR) that freelance rates don’t cover. For short projects with defined scope, agency engagements often produce better outcomes despite the higher rate — because the overhead includes quality control. Why Goa Specifically Goa has a smaller but concentrated engineering community compared to Bangalore or Hyderabad — and that concentration produces a specific advantage. Goa-based teams tend to have: Stronger English communication skills shaped by a history of international tourism and business More experience with Western client engagements and project management styles Lower talent poaching pressure than Bangalore, meaning team stability is better Quality-of-life conditions that attract senior engineers who’ve returned from Bangalore or abroad Kodework is headquartered in Goa specifically because it gives us access to experienced engineers who want to do good work without the churn and overhead of a major tech city. What to Look for When Hiring Specific AI tool fluency. Ask what tools the team uses daily. A genuine AI-augmented developer can name their tools and describe how they integrate them into workflow. Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and specific AI testing tools are the current standard. Architecture capability. Anyone can generate code with AI. The people worth hiring are those who can review what AI generates and make sound architectural decisions about what to keep, what to reject, and what to redesign. Communication pattern. Ask for a trial engagement or a paid scoping call before committing to a larger contract. How engineers communicate — their clarity, their honesty about uncertainty, their responsiveness — is as important as their code quality. References you can actually contact. Reputable teams provide references. Testimonial logos on a website without a live reference available are not references. Clear IP and confidentiality terms. Any engagement involving proprietary product work should include explicit IP assignment (all work product belongs to you) and NDA coverage. This is standard; if an agency pushes back, it’s a warning sign. Common Mistakes Hiring the cheapest option. The cost floor for Indian AI development exists because there are agencies running junior engineers with minimal oversight and billing them as senior. The output is usually lower quality than the price suggests — and fixing it costs more than the savings. No direct communication with engineers. If the agency insists all communication goes through a project manager and you can never talk directly to the engineers, you lose visibility into the actual work. For complex projects, direct engineer access matters. Ambiguous scope. “Build us a platform” is not a scope. Before any engagement starts, you need a clear description of the core features, user flows, integrations, and what “done” looks like. Ambiguous scope leads to scope disputes and cost overruns. Skipping the technical review. Have a technical advisor (internal or external) review proposals and deliverables. If you don’t have in-house technical capacity, a paid technical review of a proposal before you sign is money well spent. Working with Kodework Kodework is a small AI-powered development studio in Goa. We work with a limited number of clients at a time — specifically because we don’t scale by adding junior engineers to pad team sizes. Every project involves senior engineer involvement throughout the build. We use AI tooling to deliver at 3–5× traditional speed. Our pricing is fixed and transparent. If you want to explore a project engagement or understand whether a dedicated team arrangement makes sense for your situation, get in touch . We’ll scope it honestly and tell you whether we’re the right fit. Goa-based teams tend to have: Stronger English communication skills shaped by a history of international tourism and business More experience with Western client engagements and project management styles Lower talent poaching pressure than Bangalore, meaning team stability is better Quality-of-life conditions that attract senior engineers who’ve returned from Bangalore or abroad Kodework is headquartered in Goa specifically because it gives us access to experienced engineers who want to do good work without the churn and overhead of a major tech city. What to Look for When Hiring Specific AI tool fluency. Ask what tools the team uses daily. A genuine AI-augmented developer can name their tools and describe how they integrate them into workflow. Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and specific AI testing tools are the current standard. Architecture capability. Anyone can generate code with AI. The people worth hiring are those who can review what AI generates and make sound architectural decisions about what to keep, what to reject, and what to redesign. Communication pattern. Ask for a trial engagement or a paid scoping call before committing to a larger contract. How engineers communicate — their clarity, their honesty about uncertainty, their responsiveness — is as important as their code quality. References you can actually contact. Reputable teams provide references. Testimonial logos on a website without a live reference available are not references. Clear IP and confidentiality terms. Any engagement involving proprietary product work should include explicit IP assignment (all work product belongs to you) and NDA coverage. This is standard; if an agency pushes back, it’s a warning sign. Common Mistakes Hiring the cheapest option. The cost floor for Indian AI development exists because there are agencies running junior engineers with minimal oversight and billing them as senior. The output is usually lower quality than the price suggests — and fixing it costs more than the savings. No direct communication with engineers. If the agency insists all communication goes through a project manager and you can never talk directly to the engineers, you lose visibility into the actual work. For complex projects, direct engineer access matters. Ambiguous scope. “Build us a platform” is not a scope. Before any engagement starts, you need a clear description of the core features, user flows, integrations, and what “done” looks like. Ambiguous scope leads to scope disputes and cost overruns. Skipping the technical review. Have a technical advisor (internal or external) review proposals and deliverables. If you don’t have in-house technical capacity, a paid technical review of a proposal before you sign is money well spent. Working with Kodework Kodework is a small AI-powered development studio in Goa. We work with a limited number of clients at a time — specifically because we don’t scale by adding junior engineers to pad team sizes. Every project involves senior engineer involvement throughout the build. We use AI tooling to deliver at 3–5× traditional speed. Our pricing is fixed and transparent. If you want to explore a project engagement or understand whether a dedicated team arrangement makes sense for your situation, get in touch . closest.text: About Kevit.io Kevit Technologies Private Limited is a conversational automation and Agentic AI company based in Rajkot, Gujarat. We help businesses automate customer communication across WhatsApp, RCS, chatbots, and other messaging channels. Our clients span industries such as BFSI, telecom, education, healthcare, and various enterprise sectors. We are a growing technology company focused on innovation, automation, and building scalable products. At Kevit, software developers do more than just write code. They build products that directly impact customer experience, business growth, and AI-driven automation solutions. Why This Role Exists At Kevit, building scalable software products requires developers who can learn quickly, solve problems, and contribute across multiple technologies. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about software development, curious about technology, and willing to work in fast-paced environments where learning happens every day. This role is designed for freshers who want practical exposure to real-world software development, product engineering, cloud technologies, APIs, AI applications, and modern engineering practices. You do not need years of experience. What matters most is your problem-solving mindset, willingness to learn, and ability to build. What This Role Is A hands-on software development role involving coding, debugging, testing, building features, collaborating with teams, and contributing to real product development. What This Role Is Not A role focused only on theory, repetitive tasks, or isolated coding assignments. This position requires ownership, collaboration, learning, and active contribution. Role Overview As a Software Developer, you will be responsible for designing, building, testing, and improving software products used by businesses across multiple industries. You will work closely with product managers, senior developers, QA engineers, and infrastructure teams to develop scalable applications and automation solutions. What You Will Do Day-to-Day Responsibilities Develop, test, and maintain software applications Write clean, scalable, and reusable code Build frontend and backend features Develop and consume REST APIs Participate in code reviews and debugging activities Work with databases and optimize queries Collaborate with QA, Product, and Infrastructure teams Support deployment activities and troubleshooting Learn and work with modern engineering practices and tools As You Grow (After Internship Completion) Independently own development tasks and deliverables Improve coding standards and software quality practices Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decisions Work on automation, optimization, and scalability initiatives Take ownership of modules and product features What We Are Looking For We are not only looking for degrees or certifications. We are looking for people who enjoy solving problems, building products, and continuously learning technology. Non-Negotiables Strong logical thinking and problem-solving ability Good understanding of programming fundamentals Willingness to learn new technologies Strong ownership mindset Ability to work collaboratively in teams Good communication skills Rajkot-based or willing to relocate — this is an in-office role Good to Have Knowledge of any of Node.js, Python, React or Angular Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and APIs Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) Understanding of Git and version control systems Exposure to Docker or containerization technologies Linux or scripting knowledge Honestly — This Role Is Perfect For You If... You will love this role if... You enjoy building things and solving problems You like technology and learning continuously You are curious about AI, automation, and software products You enjoy logical thinking and debugging challenges You want hands-on product development experience This will not work if... You dislike coding or technical problem-solving You prefer repetitive work with little learning You are uncomfortable adapting to new technologies You avoid ownership or accountability You prefer isolated work without collaboration What You Will Learn Most entry-level jobs give you tasks. This one gives you engineering experience. In your first year at Kevit, you will develop skills valuable across software companies. 1) Software Development Learn professional coding practices and software engineering principles 2) Backend Development Understand APIs, server-side logic, databases, and architecture 3) Frontend Development Learn UI development and customer-facing product building 4) Cloud & Infrastructure Gain exposure to deployment, cloud platforms, and scalability 5) Product Engineering Understand how software products are built and maintained 6) AI & Automation Exposure Learn Work with conversational automation, AI systems, and modern tools Compensation & Benefits 1) Package During Internship - ₹ 6,000 CTC / Month 2) Package After Internship Completion - Between 3.6 LPA to 5 LPA 3) Employment Type - Full-Time, In-Office Eligibility Criteria Students from B.Tech – CS & IT streams 12th Standard: Minimum 65% marks (or 6.5 CGPA for Diploma students) B.Tech CPI: Minimum 7.5 CPI till date No backlogs in any semester Interview Process 1) Written Test - Aptitude, logical thinking, programming fundamentals 2) Technical Assessment - Coding skills, problem-solving approach, debugging ability, AI Prompt Engineering 3) Group Discussion - Communication, teamwork, collaboration 4) Technical Interview - Programming concepts, projects, learning mindset 5) Final Interview - Culture fit, ownership, long-term potential

nearMatches.title: Technical Support Engineer– Enterprise Customer Success
nearMatches.text: At Kapture CX, we are looking for a Technical Support Engineer - Enterprise Customer Success in our Engineering Team Who are we? Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations. Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, BigBasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank, and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation. Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia. What is this role all about? As a Technical Support Engineer you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of Kapture CX's enterprise platform. You will work directly with enterprise customers to resolve complex production challenges while collaborating with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Customer Success teams to deliver a world-class customer experience. Sounds interesting? Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role: You will own the reliability and operational health of enterprise customer deployments and ensure high platform availability. You will troubleshoot complex production issues across applications, infrastructure, databases, APIs, and integrations while driving timely resolutions. You will collaborate with enterprise customers and cross-functional teams to perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement permanent fixes, and improve platform reliability. You will write SQL queries, develop basic automation scripts, and configure Kapture products to improve operational efficiency and customer outcomes. You will proactively identify recurring issues, improve monitoring, support 24×7 operational readiness, and help maintain customer SLAs. This is a Bengaluru (Onsite) role. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility. What does success look like in this role? You consistently deliver reliable, high-performing enterprise environments, resolve production issues with speed and ownership, and build trusted relationships with customers through proactive communication and continuous operational improvements. What would make you a good fit for this role? Here are the basic requirements: You have strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to debug complex production issues. You have working knowledge of SQL and can analyze production data to investigate and resolve incidents. You have experience with scripting or programming using Java, Python, JavaScript, Bash, or similar technologies. You understand web applications, APIs, databases, distributed systems, and enterprise software environments. What are the most critical skills for this role? You can effectively troubleshoot production issues across application, infrastructure, database, and integration layers. You communicate confidently with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders during critical incidents. You demonstrate strong ownership, problem-solving abilities, and can perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to drive long-term solutions. You can balance customer expectations while collaborating with Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, and Customer Success teams. You will have an advantage if you: You have prior experience supporting SaaS, CRM, or enterprise software products. You have worked in production support, incident management, and SLA-driven environments. You have experience developing automation scripts that improve operational efficiency. You enjoy working in fast-paced, customer-facing environments where reliability is business-critical. Why should you be interested? Here's what you will gain from this role: Work directly with some of the world's leading enterprise customers and solve large-scale production challenges. Build expertise in cloud-scale SaaS operations, Site Reliability Engineering, and enterprise customer success. Collaborate with high-performing Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Customer Success teams while influencing platform reliability. Accelerate your career by working on mission-critical systems that power AI-driven customer experience solutions used globally. Does this sound like you? Click the Apply button to let us know!

Kylas CRM is a SaaS based product which helps companies streamline their sales efforts, improve customer relationships, and drive growth. It is a CRM of lead management and workflow automation. It is a fast-growing CRM with 4th Ranked in India within 2 years of commercial launch. About the Role As an Pre Sales , you will be responsible for reaching out to potential customers, pitching Kylas products, and contributing to sales growth by meeting set targets. Responsibilities: Outbound Sales Calls: Initiate and manage outbound sales calls, introducing Kylas products , understanding their needs, and offering tailored solutions. Product Knowledge: Develop a strong understanding of Kylas' product offerings to effectively communicate their benefits to clients. (Training will be provided.) Customer Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with customers by providing exceptional service, addressing inquiries, and promptly resolving issues. Market Research: Stay updated on industry trends, market developments, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for improvement and expansion. Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets, contributing to the overall sales growth and revenue generation. Sales Collateral: Create and maintain sales collateral such as brochures, product catalogs, and presentations to support sales efforts. Record Keeping: Accurately maintain records of customer interactions, sales calls, and sales progress using CRM software. Requirements: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field (preferred). Strong analytical and research skills to gather, interpret, and present data effectively. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with presentation software (e.g., Google Workspace). Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and the ability to convey complex information concisely. Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while being a strong team player. Strong organizational and time management skills to meet deadlines and handle multiple projects simultaneously. Problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to tasks. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on sales experience, work closely with a fast-growing CRM product, and contribute to the growth of innovative solutions.

handle streaming, latency, cost, rate limits, failure modes, and observability for LLM-backed features Develop AI agents - Build and orchestrate multi-step agents (planning, tool use, structured outputs, guardrails) that generate and refine learning content reliably Evaluate and iterate - Build evals and feedback loops to measure generation quality, catch regressions, and improve prompts/agents systematically Collaborate and communicate - Work with product managers, learning designers, and fellow engineers; write clear design docs, articulate trade-offs, and present your work Stay current - Track the fast-moving Gen-AI landscape (models, agent frameworks, retrieval techniques) and bring the best of it into KNOLSKAPE's products What We're Looking For Must-Have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience , with strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js on the backend; React or similar on the frontend is a plus) Hands-on Gen-AI experience - you've shipped features built on LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or similar), not just experimented in notebooks Experience building AI agents - multi-step orchestration, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and handling the messiness of non-deterministic systems Experience with RAG - embeddings, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, or similar), chunking strategies, and retrieval quality tuning Strong communication skills - you can explain technical decisions to non-engineers, write clear documentation, and collaborate effectively across teams Product mindset - you care about what authors and learners experience, not just what the model outputs Ownership and self-direction - you can take an ambiguous problem, scope it, and drive it to a shipped outcome Nice-to-Have Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or hand-rolled orchestration) Experience building LLM evals or quality measurement pipelines Familiarity with prompt engineering at scale — versioning, templating, A/B testing prompts Experience with streaming UX (SSE/WebSockets) for real-time AI interactions Exposure to speech/multi-modal AI (TTS, STT, avatar/video generation) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Docker , and CI/CD Background in ed-tech, learning platforms, or other content-generation products

closest.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
closest.text: ABOUT KOGNITOS Kognitos is the deterministic agentic AI platform for the enterprise. Our patented neurosymbolic architecture lets organizations automate finance, procurement, supply chain, and IT workflows in plain English: business rules are the executable code, every step runs exactly as written, and every action is logged and auditable. Zero hallucinations, full governance, production-ready in days. Kognitos is backed by Khosla Ventures, Prosperity7, and Wipro Ventures, recognized by Gartner and ISG, and trusted by Fortune 500 operators including PepsiCo and Wipro. THE ROLE Every enterprise wants AI in its core operations. Almost none can trust it there. Finance, procurement, and supply chain run on processes where a hallucinated number or a skipped step is not a quirk, it is an audit finding. That trust gap is why most enterprise AI never leaves the pilot stage, and closing it is the problem Kognitos exists to solve. A platform alone does not close the gap. People do. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you take Kognitos into the customer's reality: environments with fragmented data, undocumented business rules, compliance obligations, and workflow complexity no outsider understands. You embed with the customer, understand how the business actually works, reengineer the process, and bring it live in production. This is where enterprise AI stops being a promise and starts being an outcome. You own the account from the first discovery call through go-live, adoption, renewal, and growth. You are not a consultant who advises and hands off; you build the solution, drive it to outcome, stay accountable for the value it creates, and carry what you learn back into the product. The best FDEs operate across four dimensions: technical, functional, project management, and relationship. Few roles ask for all four, and fewer still let you build all four at once. This one does. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own enterprise accounts end to end: discovery, design, build, go-live, adoption, renewals, and expansion. You are accountable for the health metrics of your accounts, NPS, adoption, time-to-value, and retention, not just project completion. - Run process discovery and reengineering workshops with customers: map how the business actually works, diagnose the real bottleneck behind the stated request, and redesign processes rather than paving over them with automation. - Design and build production automations on the Kognitos platform across finance, manufacturing, and logistics processes, integrating with ERPs and enterprise systems in environments where AI governance is still being defined. - Act as the customer's trusted advisor: lead value-based discussions with stakeholders from process owners to the C-suite, set expectations honestly, and anchor every conversation in business outcomes. - Drive customer success, evangelism, and growth: build champions inside the account, surface expansion opportunities, and own the commercial health of your accounts alongside the technical delivery. - Manage multiple concurrent engagements, sequencing work to deadlines, holding the line against scope creep, and coordinating across two organizations. - Feed field learnings back to Product and Engineering; you are our eyes and ears in the customer's reality. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We hire for demonstrated ability, not credentials. No certification, degree, or year count substitutes for showing us a problem you owned from first conversation to production. If you can walk us through something you have built, a process you redesigned, and an outcome you were personally on the hook for, that carries the interview. WHAT ACTUALLY MATTERS - Critical thinking and systems design: you can take a messy, ambiguous business problem and devise a system that solves it, not just execute a spec someone hands you. - You think fast on your feet and run multiple threads at once: different accounts, different domains, different stages, without letting anything drop. - You understand business context and pain deeply, and you translate it into a working technical solution. This translation is the core skill of the role. - Strong working knowledge of how modern AI systems operate: LLMs, agents, prompt design, their failure modes, and where human-in-the-loop belongs. And daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your own work; not awareness, actual habit. - Domain knowledge in Finance & Accounting: AP/AR, invoicing, reconciliation, reporting, and close processes. Exposure to manufacturing or logistics operations is a plus. - Customer leadership: running discovery and reengineering workshops, driving adoption and evangelism, leading value-based discussions, and operating as the trusted advisor who owns the account through renewals and growth. - Ownership mentality and comfort with ambiguity. When something is broken or stuck, your instinct is to step in. Vague problems energize you rather than paralyze you. - Excellent written and verbal communication; half this job is translating between the technical and business worlds. HELPFUL, NOT MANDATORY Everything below strengthens your case but nothing here is a gate. We would rather hire someone who has shipped one real system end to end than someone with every logo on this list. - Automation and RPA platforms: UiPath, Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere, Workato, or similar. - Enterprise systems: ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite; experience integrating against enterprise APIs and identity systems. - Python or scripting, and familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks. - Prior experience in Professional Services, Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Customer Success at enterprise software or AI companies. WHAT SETS GREAT CANDIDATES APART - You have built something real with AI, automations, agents, or applications, and can walk us through it. - You have a point of view on where AI and automation are going and how they change enterprise software. - You have grown accounts, not just delivered projects: renewals, expansions, and referenceable champions. - You have worked at the intersection of technology and business transformation and are energized by both sides. WHY KOGNITOS - Stand where the value is created. The model wars get the headlines; the deployment layer gets the value. You will work exactly where enterprise AI succeeds or fails, on production systems for Fortune 500 customers, not demos. - Proven platform, serious customers. Kognitos is backed by Khosla Ventures and trusted by Fortune 500 companies across finance, manufacturing, and logistics. You inherit real accounts with real stakes from day one. - A team that measures itself honestly. Customer outcome metrics, NPS, adoption, time-to-value, are how we run delivery, and FDEs own them for their accounts. High standards, and the playbooks to meet them. - Four-dimensional growth. Few roles let you build technical, domain, project, and executive-relationship muscle at once. FDEs here develop a range most career tracks force you to ignore, and the ceiling is leadership, not senior IC. - Ownership that compounds. You are the face of the account. Your wins are visible to customers, leadership, and the market, and your feedback shapes the product roadmap directly. - The basics, done right. Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits. FINAL NOTE You do not need to match all of the listed expectations to apply for this position. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES PROVIDER Kognitos is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

closest.title: Associate Product Manager
closest.text: The Kuhoo Story: Where Dreams Meet Data Picture this: A brilliant engineering student from a middle-class family in Tier-2 India has the potential to revolutionize technology, but traditional lenders see only their father's modest income. This is the story that sparked Kuhoo Finance—a fintech revolution that believes in Aatmanirbharta (self-reliance) and transforms "what if" into "why not." Today, we're not just another NBFC. We're dream architects, wielding AI and data science like modern-day magic wands to unlock the future earning potential hidden within every student. With our fresh RBI NBFC license, we're scaling from facilitating dreams to directly funding them—offering education loans up to ₹2 crore across engineering, management, medical programs, and cutting-edge upskilling initiatives. Our Numbers Tell Stories: 100,000+ student applications processed (each one a unique dream) ₹375+ crore in loans facilitated (translating to countless transformed lives) 15,000 borrowers who now call us their launchpad to success 3 years of redefining how education financing works in India Our DNA : The Five Core Values That Drive Us Ownership: We don't just work here; we build the future here Passion for Excellence: Good enough is never good enough Impact: Every line of code, every decision shapes a student's tomorrow Curiosity: We question everything and innovate fearlessly. Fairness: At Kuhoo, fairness is the foundation of our decisions, ensuring equal opportunities and transparent growth for all. At Kuhoo, we've created more than a workplace—we've built an ecosystem where innovation thrives, execution is an art form, and meritocracy isn't just a buzzword but our operating system. Role Overview: A Product Manager at Kuhoo is an in-house entrepreneur who loves engaging with customers, uncovering stated and unstated problems and finding the right product features to solve those problems. At its core, product management at Kuhoo is about understanding the customer and using technology and analytics to deliver great experiences. Building a product is a highly collaborative effort, the candidate must be a strong team player with a commitment to perfection and possessing deep analytical skills. A successful candidate will be a self-starter with excellent business acumen, product management skills and the ability to cut through the noise and identify the most important tasks and projects. We are a data driven organization and we like focusing on results, KPIs and outcomes. What will you do? This is a key role for Kuhoo and requires a lot of cross-functional coordination Strategic Product Leadership: Define the product's value proposition, conduct competitive analysis, prioritize features, and drive user acquisition and retention strategies by collaborating closely with teams across design, business development, engineering, legal, and operations. Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Identify gaps, pain points, and opportunities where credit solutions can transform the lives of students, parents, and partners, shaping innovative product offerings. Product Roadmap Ownership: Develop compelling user stories, define clear customer and product requirements, and own the product roadmap from concept to execution, continually refining specifications and architecture throughout the product lifecycle. Lending Lifecycle Expertise : Build modular capabilities across the lending lifecycle, including acquisition, onboarding, credit-modelling, decision-making, and post-sales service experiences. Partnership Collaboration: Collaborate closely with multiple lending partners to create differentiated, industry-leading value propositions for various business segments, driving innovation and competitive advantage for Kuhoo. Ownership & Innovation: Bring strong ownership, thought leadership, and product development expertise to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Key Responsibilities Areas End-to-End Product Delivery : Lead the entire product lifecycle from conception to launch, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and business strategy. Product Requirement Documentation : Develop comprehensive product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories based on data insights, market analysis, and customer feedback. Product Enhancement & Optimization : Build and maintain a robust pipeline of tasks and projects to improve product features and optimize critical customer journeys. Establish a framework for prioritizing and executing key initiatives. Feature Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration : Oversee the successful delivery of features, including quality assurance, testing, and managing trade-offs to ensure a seamless product experience. Portfolio Management & Agile Methodologies : Manage a portfolio of products and demonstrate proficiency in product management methodologies, particularly agile software development. Growth Opportunities & Feature Adoption : Identify opportunities for significant business growth by increasing user engagement with product features and driving adoption of existing offerings. Funnel Optimization : Analyse, design, and optimize conversion funnels to encourage cross-selling and upselling opportunities at key stages of the customer journey. Other Requirements: Experience: 1-2 years of experience in product management. Have a good understanding of Product Management principles and processes. Experience in writing user stories, wireframes, and customer interaction Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret data, solve problems, and make informed decisions based on insights. Strong Communication : Clear, effective communication with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, both verbally and in writing. Customer Focus: Understanding customer needs and translating feedback into product improvements. Basic Project Management : Familiarity with prioritizing tasks and managing projects, ideally within Agile or Scrum frameworks. Adaptability & Collaboration: Willingness to learn, adapt quickly, and work well in a team-oriented environment. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life. We can’t wait to hear from you!

Job Location: Bangalore (Work from Office – we build fast, together) Who We’re Looking For This is not a regular job. We want someone who is restlessly curious, thrives in chaos, and wants to leave a dent. You’ll have the freedom, responsibility, and impact that only comes with early-stage product building. Shape tech decisions, team culture, and the DNA of the app. You Might Be The One If You Have 1-3 years of solid Android development experience. Have built and shipped apps from scratch – and loved it. Are hungry to build something impactful and world-class. Take ownership without being asked – and bring solutions, not problems. Are high on energy, low on ego, and never say “that’s not my job.” Want to be in the room where 0-to-1 decisions happen. What You’ll Get Founding team energy – your work directly shapes the product and team. Infinite learning – fast pace, big challenges, full ownership. A startup in stealth with the backing of giants (Sequoia, Tiger Global). A chance to build something you’d proudly tell your grandkids about. If you believe you’re not just another engineer but someone who can build, break, and lead, let’s talk.

closest.title: Customer Support Engineer - SFS/Circl
closest.text: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Works under the supervision of Manager or Senior CSE. Primarily responsible for customer service activities associated with updating, troubleshooting, diagnosing and repairing of highly complex capital equipment at customer sites and trade shows. Represents the company to the customer and assumes accountability for customer satisfaction with service. Assures operational quality of system equipment. Coordinates actions with customers to minimize down time. Provides assistance to Installation Engineers in resolving problems. Evaluates, analyzes, diagnoses and troubleshoots technical equipment problems via telephone or at customer site. Ensures equipment enhances customer production. Repairs and updates equipment at customer facility. Repairs of system level problems (which have multiple causes and for which no standard procedures exist) are based on CSE's technical knowledge, education, training and certification CSE's may access and determine the problems existing in customers' processes such as chemical leaks or contamination, and as a result may recommend shutdown of customer fab due to unsafe conditions. Prepares fields service reports on customer support activity and provides documentation to other supporting functions supporting functions on re-occurring problems. Assists in the preparation of quotes for customers based on labor, travel expenses incurred and parts needed. CSE's use discretion and assist regional admin in preparing quotes based on reason for equipment failure, time to prepare etc. Assists other field service engineers as appropriate. Provides guidance and technical assistance to Installation Engineer on installations at customer sites or on installing/dismantling demonstration machines. Travels by car or commercial transportation to customer facility. Contribute to the Capturing, Re-use, Collaboration, and Improvement of knowledge using available systems. Minimum Qualifications BS +2 yrs experience or equivalent years of experience Base Pay Range: $27.46 - $46.69 Per Hour Primary Location: USA-AZ-Phoenix-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at +1-408-352-2808 to request accommodation. Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA . Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

closest.title: R&D Engineer 6, Software
closest.text: Overview Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. Job Summary: This job is in the R&D group of Keysight High Frequency Measurement Center of Excellence (HFM COE). HFM COE is responsible for developing world-leading network analyzers, signal analyzers, signal generators and transceivers that are utilized to design and test next-generation products in cellular communications, satellite systems, automotive collision avoidance, and other high frequency wireless systems. We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to serve as a technical leader, responsible for architecting, designing, and developing complex large-scale software for Signal Analyzers. The ideal candidate will possess extensive full stack knowledge spanning from lower-level hardware/firmware integration, through measurement algorithm design, to customer-facing application implementation, and be able to leverage that knowledge to deliver software solutions to our customers. This position is part of an Agile team and will participate in the full software development lifecycle. As a technical leader, the successful candidate must be able to collaborate with other functional teams to translate broad concepts and business strategies into structured solutions, deliver complex and high impact designs, address performance and optimization concerns, and drive the delivery of cutting-edge technologies that shape the future with passion and motivation. Responsibilities Lead the design, development and documentation for new features or existing feature enhancements driven by customer requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and prioritize requirements. Review, analyze and optimize architecture of the product with innovative solutions. Develop and improve GUI & RUI usability continuously. Define and develop interfaces between firmware (hardware control) and software. Follow coding rules and conduct code reviews with constructive feedback. Leverage RF measurement science knowledge in software designs. Provide leadership and mentoring to other team members. Qualifications BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or other related engineering discipline with software emphasis 14+ years software engineering experience, with consistent success designing and delivering solutions. 3+ years technical leadership experience Strong knowledge and experience in object oriented (OO) design and programming. Proven experience in building , testing, and debugging software Proficiency in C#, C++, .NET, WPF, MVVM Familiarity with Agile development and tools such as TFS, GIT, Jenkins, Jira, etc.' Demonstrated ability to work with a team and collaborate effectively with across global teams of engineers achieve objectives Understand business and customer needs and apply knowledge to create innovative solutions Good organizational skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, results driven environment Proven ability to deliver complex and challenging assignments Excellent written and verbal communications skills Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with a passion for learning and professional growth Preferred Qualifications: Strong RF Measurement Science knowledge and telecommunication specifications Experience with Measurement Instruments (signal analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, Oscilloscopes, etc.) Careers Privacy Statement ***Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or other related engineering discipline with software emphasis 14+ years software engineering experience, with consistent success designing and delivering solutions. 3+ years technical leadership experience Strong knowledge and experience in object oriented (OO) design and programming. Proven experience in building , testing, and debugging software Proficiency in C#, C++, .NET, WPF, MVVM Familiarity with Agile development and tools such as TFS, GIT, Jenkins, Jira, etc.' Demonstrated ability to work with a team and collaborate effectively with across global teams of engineers achieve objectives Understand business and customer needs and apply knowledge to create innovative solutions Good organizational skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, results driven environment Proven ability to deliver complex and challenging assignments Excellent written and verbal communications skills Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with a passion for learning and professional growth Preferred Qualifications: Strong RF Measurement Science knowledge and telecommunication specifications Experience with Measurement Instruments (signal analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, Oscilloscopes, etc.) Careers Privacy Statement ***Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

matches.title: Engineer, Variant Configuration - KTOC
matches.text: Company: KONE is a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, making people’s journeys safe, convenient, and reliable with smart and sustainable People Flow®. In a world where cities are constantly evolving and more and more people choose to live in them, we at KONE stand with one clear aim: to shape the future of cities. We make urban life more vibrant and livable. And we do it by enabling safe, sustainable, and effortless people flow for all. We help cities leave a positive mark on the planet - for the next century and beyond. We shape the future of cities. KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI) is where the magic happens at KONE. It's where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies. KONE R&D brings together top talent from different disciplines into an industry-leading product and technology organization. We thrive in solving complex customer challenges, connecting legacy with the latest technologies across hardware and software engineering. In fact, roughly half of our R&D roles are in software. Agile ways of working mean that we are better able to meet our customers’ rapidly evolving needs for speed and innovation, in a global environment. R&D unit in KTI is responsible for developing digital services at KONE. It’s the development engine for our Digital Services such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Office Flow and Partnership Ecosystem. Our common goal at KONE is to keep the end users safe and people flow uninterrupted. KONE moves 2 billion people every day and that means our services can really make cities better places to live Why this role? We are seeking a Variant Configuration Engineer with expertise in CPQ Developments. This role will focus on Development and Maintenance of Product Models for Elevator & Escalator products manufactured at various KONE Factories while maintaining high operational standards. The successful candidate will have a strong technical background, experience in the SAPVC or PDMVC and the ability to manage operational KPIs effectively. The role requires a hands-on approach and the ability to work comfortably in diverse cultural environments. Some travel is required. What will you be doing? Creation, Maintenance & Deployment of Elevator & Escalator CPQ Product Models. Closely work with R&D/Project team to manage variants for New Products/Releases To ensure the functionality of KONE product configurations by programming and testing these product configurations using the programming languages defined for this specific job Flexible to work with any CPQ tools like SAP, CAMOS, VariPDM Preparation of reports for data analysis & ensuring timely and quality project delivery. Debug CPQ issues from Sales Team, factory, and suppliers. Required Skills: Good knowledge in SAP, VariPDM & VariClient. Strong Knowledge in C++ or Java (Object oriented programming) CPQ (Configure, Price & Quote) proficiency is an asset. Basic knowledge in VB & Python Strong knowledge in MS Office Tools Preferred Skills: Data Analytics, AI & ML expertise is preferable. Elevator knowledge is added advantage to this profile. Knowledge in KONE Products and Processes. Are you the one? Bachelor’s degree in engineering (ECE/E&I/CSE/IT) / MCA / MSC Computer science 2 - 5 years of Relevant experience Good Debugging and Analytical skills Strong written and verbal communication skills. Attention to procedure and guidelines. What do we offer? Development and growth opportunities within a global organization. Warm and friendly international working environment Being part of an industry leader in sustainability. At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life. Read more on https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html
